metaDescription: CPT 99439 explained: the CCM add-on for each extra 20 minutes of clinical staff time. Monthly limit, documentation, 2026 rate and pairing rules.
summary: An add-on code reported with 99490 for each additional 20 minutes of clinical staff time in the same month. It lifts revenue on patients who need more than the base amount of coordination.
time: Each additional 20 minutes beyond the first 20
performer: Clinical staff under the billing practitioner's direction
frequency: Add-on to 99490; CMS caps the number of units per month
requirements: 99490 already met for the same patient and month
A running time log that shows the minutes beyond the first 20
The same consent and care plan that support 99490
Notes showing the extra time was real care coordination, not duplicate effort
pitfalls: Adding time with no note describing what the staff member did

faqs.question: Can 99439 be billed on its own?
faqs.answer: No. It is an add-on and is only reported together with 99490 for the same patient and month.

faqs.question: How many units of 99439 can a practice bill per month?
faqs.answer: CMS limits the number of units per patient per month. Check the current Physician Fee Schedule before relying on any unit count.
